meta.name: seo-audit
meta.description: Use when reviewing a page or site for organic search, or diagnosing why something isn't ranking: crawl and index signals, on-page elements, content quality, and how to order the fixes.

copy.tagline: 诊断网站排名问题,按优先级给出修复建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果网站搜索排名不理想,想找出原因并知道先改什么。
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose ranking issues and get prioritized fixes.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your site isn't ranking well and you need actionable, prioritized fixes.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按优先级分五层审查网页:能否被搜索引擎收录、网站基础(HTTPS、速度等)、页面元素(标题、描述等)、内容是否优于现有排名、外部可信度。它只用能验证的抓取数据和资料做判断,并给出按重要性排序的修复清单。
howto.when: 当用户请它审查某个网页或网站的搜索表现、诊断排名问题,或询问为何内容没被收录时触发。

howto.what_en: Claude audits web pages in priority order: indexability, site foundation, on-page elements, content quality, and credibility. It relies only on verifiable fetch data and sources, then outputs a ranked fix list.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to audit a page or site's search performance, diagnose why something isn't ranking, or check indexing issues.

say_en.note: Outputs findings by layer with priority.
